name: Shirohebi
source:
Once departing Yamatai Village for the mountains, she returned leading a band of monsters to attack it. She was recruited by Black Alice in order to take over Yamatai Village. Since she intended to rule over the village, and not destroy it, she avoided widespread slaughter in the attack.

Both sisters seem to be related to the late Queen Lamia. Directly following the Queen Lamia’s unexpected death, though her name was originally put forward as a successor, a large fight broke out over who would claim the seat. Due to this repeated rivalry for the position, the seat of Queen Lamia is still vacant.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
